newsitem.title: USA: Omega Health Systems completes acquisition.
newsitem.headline: Omega Health Systems completes acquisition.

text.p: Omega Health Systems Inc said on Tuesday that it had completed the acquisition of the assets of the Faust-Gelvin Eye Center and a 50 percent interest in the practice's associated ambulatory surgery center.

In connection with the transaction, Omega issued 169,000 shares of its common stock and paid $1.7 million in cash. The transaction will be accounted for as a purchase, the company said in a statement.
Omega also entered into long-term agreements to manage both the practice and surgery center, the company said.
The practice and the ambulatory surgery center had combined revenues of about $2.7 million in 1996, it added.

"This practice is an excellent fit as we expand in the Midwest. This is the fourth acquisition we have completed in 1997 and we will continue to pursue acquisition opportunities during the rest of the year," said Thomas Lewis, chief executive officer of Omega.
Omega Health Systems is an eye care services company providing services to optometry and ophthalmology practices.
